purpose: Compare two regularized finite-window LLR=0 summaries for collaborator-facing visualization without preselecting a model or claiming a thermodynamic phase boundary.
eligible_q_rows: All sixteen B11 rows with two-sided lower brackets; no extrapolation above q=0.75.
shared_likelihood: Weighted Bernoulli cross-entropy against the continuous posterior upward-trend probability; model logit=(p-p_boundary(q))/0.025.
shared_constraints: Both curves are single-valued p(q) and remain inside the linearly interpolated audited lower/upper bracket envelope.

spline.kind: PCHIP interpolation of optimized bounded knot fractions

posterior_propagation.kind: independent Jeffreys-Beta latent-LER draws projected to per-cell slope signs, followed by refitting both models
posterior_propagation.limitation: Not a seed-cluster bootstrap or thermodynamic-boundary confidence interval.

stop_rule: Stop after both branches, sixteen held-out-row fits per branch, and 48 shared posterior-propagation refits; do not add models, data, q rows, or extrapolation.
